title: Governed hiring agent for branch roles (in-house, skill-based)
accountable_executive: Meera Iyer, Chief Human Resources Officer

use_case.purpose: An AI agent screens applications for branch roles against a cleared job specification, advances strong candidates, rejects only candidates who clearly fail a verifiable legal or operational requirement, and sends every judgment-based or unclear case to a recruiter, under a runtime guardian.
use_case.problem_statement: About 60,000 applications a year; 14 recruiters spend an estimated 70% of their time on first-pass reading; time-to-hire 38 days.
expected_benefits: Recruiters read only borderline, unclear and flagged applications plus audit samples
Same job-related criteria for every applicant
use_case.alternatives_considered: TalentSort v2 (vendor tool, approved with conditions as assist-only ordering); more recruiters (about three times the cost).

system.vendor_name: In-house agent on a general-purpose model, with a governed skill library
system.ai_output: Proposed action per candidate with quoted evidence: advance, reject on failed hard requirement, hold for a person, human-only

input_features: Relevant sales experience with customers (months, capped at 24)
Able to work at branch (hard requirement)
data.training_data: No machine-learned scoring model. Scores come from published, deterministic rules derived from the job analysis; the language model reads resumes and writes notes but does not set scores.
data.accuracy_controls: Candidates see and can correct the parsed profile; low parse confidence routes to a person; parser tested on real CV formats.

source_documents: Shadow pilot: 1,500 applicants scored by the skills-first method (synthetic)
assumptions: automation_level 'auto_reject_hard_requirements': the agent may reject alone only on a cleanly failed, documented hard requirement; all judgment-based rejections are confirmed by a recruiter.
generative_llm_scoring recorded false: the language model does not set scores; scores come from deterministic scripts. The model's notes are labelled as judgment.
vendor_reuses_data_for_training recorded false on the basis of the enterprise terms with the model provider; Legal to confirm in writing.
Candidate data is processed by the model provider outside India; recorded as a cross-border transfer.
claims_needing_evidence: Enterprise terms prohibiting the model provider from training on candidate data: Legal to file the clause.
Parser accuracy on regional CV formats: report to be attached.
